proposal.description: A host read clears only the top byte of fault_time (FTIME_2, the byte whose read raises the pulse), so the two low bytes keep the old episode start time
proposal.reason: After the host reads a record whose start time had non-zero low bytes, fault_time reads back non-zero (the old low 16 bits) while fault_reg is empty. This lasts until the next episode re-stamps it, but the header says fault_time is cleared with the bits.

proposal.description: Episode start is detected only during soft start, as if every fault episode began with a failed start-up, so a first cause captured in S_RUN does not stamp fault_time
proposal.reason: A first fault that appears while the converter is in S_RUN (OTP, UVLO, a window trip or a latch trip) is still recorded in fault_reg, but fault_time stays at zero instead of latching timestamp_ms.
